method: Built-in image generation from the existing farmer reference; original generated PNGs preserved

digging.poses: position spade, drive blade, lever soil, lift scoop

filling.poses: scoop, lift loaded shovel, tip soil, lower shovel

planting.poses: hold packet, kneel, sprinkle seeds, pat soil

watering.poses: hold can, raise can, pour, lower can

mowing.poses: prepare scythe, low sweeping cut, follow-through with clippings, return to ready

measurement: scripts/measure-task-atlases.cjs records cell rectangles and boot anchors without editing the images
